Update for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric, Linux). Draft, to be finished at release time.

- New handwritten letters for the sky lyrics. In the settings, **Look → Font** now has three choices: Smooth, Handwritten and Minecraft. The top bar keeps the smooth letters so it stays easy to read. Hebrew lines still show in the Hebrew font.
- New help pages for players: [Questions and answers](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md) and [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md), covering missing lyrics, the wrong song, lyrics that come early or late, shaders, and where the settings are saved.

Install: drop the jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API (see the [README](https://github.com/arbelonson-source/belis-skylyrics#install)).
